text: {"reply":"Thank you, Mr. Watson. I have not booked the inspection yet. I also need to correct my colleague's earlier message. Your invoice RO-327743 shows labour of 2.9 hours at $165 per hour and parts of $131.05. The total is $688.79 CAD, taxes included. I do not see a line for \"shop supplies\" or an $840 charge. Our records also show your car as owned, with no lease end date, so I can't book a lease-return inspection from them. A person will review both points, including your request about the charge, and the service manager will look at the dispute. Nothing has been removed or promised.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"policy_limit","summary":"Customer disputes an $840 'shop supplies' charge on RO-327743 and wants it removed. The invoice shows only labour and parts totalling $688.79 CAD, with no shop supplies line, and its status is disputed. The customer also asked to book a lease-return inspection at Scarborough for a lease ending 2026-11-27, but the vehicle record shows the car as owned with no lease end date. No booking was made. An earlier colleague message wrongly implied the charge would be removed, and it was corrected. Please review the billing dispute and the record conflict.","policy_rules_cited":["P06","P08","P12","P14"]}
